one_line: A named parent moment plus "three quick activities" in the first line, with big key-word subtitles.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close-up of four wooden magnetic letters on a whiteboard; 0:01 a hand draws an arrow under the first letter. Voice and text: "אם הילד שלכם עובר" "לכתוב", "לכתב" large, "קבלו שלוש פעילויות", "צ'ק." large (0:05).
q1_hook.why: It names a specific moment parents of first graders meet, and promises three quick activities, said and written together (H2, H6, T3). A hand moves by 0:01 (E1). But no person opens it, so the voice carries the human side (H4).

beats.what: Magnetic letters; a hand draws arrows and places cursive magnets; "קבלו שלוש פעילויות"
beats.why: Promise of three, with action at once

beats.what: Camera pans along two rows of matched magnets; "למי שאין מגנטים"
beats.why: Activity one, with a no-magnet variant

beats.what: A hand writes print and red cursive letters on the board; "שאני ממש אוהבת אותה"
beats.why: Her favourite activity next, a personal lure

beats.what: Print letters one side, cursive the other; green lines drawn to match; "תשנו את סדר האותיות"
beats.why: Activity two with a tip to vary it

beats.what: Paper with one print letter on top, scattered cursive letters; yellow marker circles matches; "חצי דקה על השעון"
She speaks to the lens in a therapy room, points at the viewer; "תעקבו אחרי"
beats.why: A face and one ask after the value

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at the end, "תעקבו אחרי". Caption: save ("שמרי את הסרטון"), send ("שלחי לחברה שהילד שלה בדיוק עובר לכתב"), follow. No question to answer.
q2_flow.why: "Three activities" gives a clear count to wait for, and "the next one I really like" restarts interest (R3). A rule for each activity makes it reusable (R7). The creator's face appears only at the end. 38 s suits a short list (R2), and the last 5 s add no new tip (R1).

q3_cta.what: Spoken and on screen 0:33 to 0:38: "לעוד תוכן מקצועי של מרפאה בעיסוק וטיפים שיעזרו לכם" "תעקבו אחרי". Caption: follow, "שמרי את הסרטון", and "שלחי לחברה שהילד שלה בדיוק עובר לכתב וזה יעזור לה גם".
q3_cta.why: The send ask names the recipient and a reason, a good fit for reach (C4). The follow is said and shown after the value (C6). But the caption stacks three different asks, follow, save and send (C1), each with a purpose, not bait (C2).

q4_shown.what: Wooden magnetic Hebrew letters on a whiteboard, a hand drawing and matching letters 0:00 to 0:24; paper with scattered letters and a yellow marker 0:24 to 0:33; the creator's face and a therapy room 0:33 to 0:38. No child, no price, no brand named.
q4_shown.why: Hands carry the demo and a face appears only to say who she is (S4). Her stated role, "מרפאה בעיסוק", gives the advice authority (S6). No child does the activity, so there is no result, but also no child's face (S5).

q5_edit.what: 10 shots in 38 s, about 3.8 s each; a pan at 0:05, cuts by step. Voice runs 0:00 to 0:37 with bold subtitles in short phrases and a few enlarged words ("לכתב", "צ'ק.", "בלשי"). No speed changes. Ends on face and pointing hand.
q5_edit.why: Text and a hand move in the first second (E1). Short, synced subtitles with key words enlarged suit sound off or on (E4, T2). The cut pace of about 4 s keeps a moderate rhythm within one theme (E2).

q6_topic.what: Three quick activities to help a child move from print to cursive letters, from a child OT; serves parents of first graders learning to write.
q6_topic.why: Starting cursive is a real school-age concern, and the caption names the child "בדיוק עובר לכתב" (K6, K7). Tips come in a friendly voice ("קל בטירוף") and stay modest (K4). A reusable list is worth a save or a send (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Close-ups of a whiteboard, with a pan, then a wider board with glare and a dark reflection over it 0:16 to 0:23; top-down paper in daylight; a selfie in a therapy room with a ball behind her, speaking to the lens and pointing.
q7_filmed.why: Direct address at the end speaks to the viewer (F6). Top-down paper is easy to read (F5). Letters fill the frame in the first shots, but the wide board with glare makes the print small and washed out (F4, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold white subtitles with a dark outline, no box, short phrases about three quarters down the frame, over the picture: "אם הילד שלכם עובר" (0:00), "לכתב" large (0:02), "הדפוס לכתב:" (0:07), "חצי דקה על השעון" (0:25), "בלשי" large (0:27), "לעוד תוכן מקצועי" (0:33), "תעקבו אחרי" (0:37).
q8_text.caption: "עוד סרטון שנולד מהשטח! והפעם מהצורך של המטופלים שלי שעוברים לכתוב מדפוס לכתב." About 186 words: tips, her role, save, send and follow asks, 5 hashtags (#מרפאהבעיסוק #כתיבה #אותיות ...). No disclosure needed.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second states the topic (T3), and subtitles of the whole voice work muted (T1, T2). They sit in the lower band that buttons cover (T4). The caption uses searchable words (כתב, דפוס, אותיות) and exactly 5 hashtags (T7).

weak_points: No child doing the activity; glare and a dark reflection on the board for 7 s; subtitles in the lower band; three asks in the caption; a long 186-word caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a "three quick ideas" Reel with the book on a table: hands only, big one-word subtitles, a 5 s face sign-off with a single ask.
not_verified: Whether any music plays. Whether the voice is live or recorded later. Whether the Giotto-labelled marker at 0:01 is a collaboration (no partnership wording). Corrections to coded file: the first large word is "לכתב" (0:02), the later one reads "צ'ק."; the index counts 10 shots, not 7.
